stem:
Meera does a science activity at home in Jaipur. She puts two strips of metal into a lemon and connects them with wires to a small lamp.
Which setup will work as a cell and make the lamp glow?

options.text: two copper strips pushed into the lemon and connected to the lamp
a copper strip and an iron strip pushed into the lemon and connected to the lamp
a copper strip and an iron strip placed in a glass of plain water and connected to the lamp
a copper strip and an iron strip held in the air above the lemon and connected to the lamp

teacher.key_rationale: A working Voltaic cell needs two electrodes of different metals and an electrolyte. Only B has two different metals (copper and iron) with the lemon juice acting as the electrolyte. A uses the same metal for both electrodes, C lacks an electrolyte (plain water does not conduct well enough here), and D has no electrolyte contact at all.
